releases.body:
同步 `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.8（[magpie-community/plugins#1108](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/1108)，合并提交 1429620）。

1. **往上滚立刻离开底部（#2）**：贴底时只要用户往上滚，哪怕离底部还不到 60px，也会马上停止跟随；内容增长、布局变化不会把视图拉回底部。只有往下滚到底部附近、真正到底、点「回到底部」或发送消息时才会重新贴底。
2. **用 IDE 打开项目、在资源管理器中显示（#3）**：顶栏新增「用 IDE 打开」按钮（依次查找 Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、Zed、IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、Sublime Text）；文件面板可以在资源管理器 / 访达 / 文件管理器中显示文件。启动用参数数组执行，不经过 shell；显示的路径必须解析在项目目录内。

安全模型不变：页面 token（`x-agent-console`）、Host 校验、WS hello 5 秒鉴权；新功能都走已认证的 WebSocket。

npm：`magpie-agent-console@1.3.8`

releases.name: Agent Console 1.3.7
releases.body:
同步 `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.6 + 1.3.7（[magpie-community/plugins#787](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/787)、[#792](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/792)，合并提交 86778e6）。

1. **长回复贴底（1.3.6，#787）**：虚拟列表中行实测高度超过预估、流式输出、隐藏视图重新显示时，对话都保持贴在底部；只有用户手势向上滚动才离开底部。另含 #786 审阅跟进：ACP 会话跳过的默认模型不再记为已同步，下一次空闲发送会重试。
2. **流式输出不再闪烁（1.3.7，#792）**：代码块（语言标签、行号、换行/复制按钮）与 Markdown 同一次渲染完成；pending 引用稳定 + Zustand 字段级选择器，流式期间外壳不再整体重渲染；`scrollbar-gutter: stable`，底部留白移入最后一个虚拟行，消除逐行跳动。未标注语言的代码块恢复 `highlightAuto` 自动识别与语言标签（流式输出时只有末尾未闭合的代码块暂显示 "text"）。DOMPurify 恢复为仅 html 配置，模型写入的 `<svg>` 会被移除。
3. **Windows 桌面端断线重连（1.3.7，#792）**：不再回跳 `http://wails.localhost`（WebView2 下会落到灰色错误页）；断线后通知 Magpie 显示原生「重试」卡片，点击即重建页面与服务；会清除旧版本缓存的 wails 回跳地址。`magpie web` 仍保留自动重连。

安全模型不变：页面 token（`x-agent-console`）、Host 校验、WS hello 5 秒鉴权；回跳地址仅接受回环地址上的 Magpie 页面。

npm：`magpie-agent-console@1.3.7`

releases.name: Agent Console 1.3.5
releases.body:
同步 `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.5（[magpie-community/plugins#786](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/786)，合并提交 856ad93）。

1. **Windows 桌面端断线重连**：Wails WebView2（`http://wails.localhost`，仅 Windows、无端口）守护进程重启后支持自动与手动重连；缺少宿主回跳地址时，通过 Magpie iframe `{ magpie:1, method:"error" }` 重建兜底。
2. **模型刷新与默认模型同步**：模型选择框新增 `↻` 刷新；按各 Agent 身份携带 Token 读取 Magpie `/v1/models`，过滤已关闭/未展示模型（含 Codex ChatGPT 裸模型名匹配）；Magpie/Agent 配置文件变更自动失效模型缓存；对话选「默认」时，空闲下一轮自动同步 Magpie 最新默认模型。

安全模型不变：页面 token（`x-agent-console`）、Host 校验、WS hello 5 秒鉴权。

releases.name: Agent Console 1.3.4
releases.body:
Sync with `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.4 ([magpie-community/plugins#768](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/768), merge commit 39f5427).

Stop now ends the turn at once, and a resend right after it is safe, on all three paths:

- **ACP** (Devin, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, dsh): `session/cancel` goes as a notification, the local turn ends at once, and a resend waits for the cancel and the previous prompt to settle.
- **Claude**: the result FIFO (`turnGen`, `awaitingResult`, `skipResultGens`) lives on each CLI process, and a replaced CLI's leftover stdout is ignored. After a crash the queue stays open, so the next send resumes with `--resume`.
- **Codex**: a turn whose `turn/start` response arrives after Stop is interrupted by its own response id.

Security model unchanged: page token (`x-agent-console` header), Host check, WS hello auth within 5 s.

npm: `magpie-agent-console@1.3.4`

releases.name: Agent Console 1.3.3
releases.body:
Sync with `@magpie-community/page-agent-console` 1.3.3 ([magpie-community/plugins#760](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/760), merge commit 41e90a1). This sync is based on merged upstream `main`, so it also includes community **1.3.2** from [#758](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/758) (Codex picker reads `model_catalog_json`).

- **Stuck 等待授权 / Permission-wait unstick**: if a permission request is still open when its turn ends, the daemon cancels it. The page only shows “等待授权” when a card still has buttons the user can press.
- **添加到对话 icon**: speech bubble (outline + three dots) instead of the quote mark that read as garbled.
- **Sidebar status dots**: blinks light/dark while running, green after a completed turn, red on failure, amber while waiting for permission.
- **Reconnect button**: disconnect / invalid-link end states always offer **重新连接**. The last safe Magpie back URL is kept in `sessionStorage` so a click can still recover when `#b=` is missing.
- **Reconnect on return**: coming back to the page (`visibilitychange` → visible, or window focus) checks the child at once. After a 4 s probe, a silent child is recovered; if an end state is already showing, coming back is the same as clicking Reconnect.

Security model unchanged: page token (`x-agent-console` header), Host check, WS hello auth within 5 s. `safeBack` still only accepts a loopback Magpie plugin page URL.

npm: `magpie-agent-console@1.3.3`
